descriptionHtml:
Bug B19 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Retention / purge is not implemented per UAT 3.6: 13-hour Important Points and 37-hour tasks, handoffs and vitals are still there; nothing is purged unless a device opens the app; past 500 patients some charts are skipped

Tickets: TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Note: One root cause behind 19 cases; the windows themselves are decision D6

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S11 Tasks: open vs completed × chart last processed × mode

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Hospital open tasks are deleted 36 h after the chart was last processed: an open task on a chart not processed for 37 h is gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: open tasks)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T4 Hospital completed tasks are deleted 16 h after they were completed. (TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: completed tasks 16 h); UAT 3.6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U9 Nursing Home keeps the last two visits: notes, transcripts and medication events from older visits are deleted; the chronic medication list and open tasks persist until changed; … (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT 3.6 (Nursing Home: pre-round 12 h, encounter 12 h, note 18 h, last two visits); UAT 3.3; TFA-94699 AC 1 (Nursing Home line)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Hospital patients with: an open task, chart last processed 35 h ago; an open task, chart last processed 37 h ago; an open task created 37 h ago on a chart processed 2 h ago; a completed task done 15 h ago and one done 17 h ago. One Nursing Home resident with an open task untouched for 72 h

When Each context's purge runs; raw task lists read

Then Hospital open task: kept at 35 h and when the chart was processed 2 h ago (even though the task is 37 h old), deleted when the chart was last processed 37 h ago. Completed task: kept at 15 h, deleted at 17 h. Nursing Home open task: kept

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.6 (open tasks 36 h after the chart was last processed; completed tasks 16 h; Nursing Home open tasks persist until changed) and the TFA-94699 table; which actions count as processing is Q5

Where it ran: local retention (clock moved to check retention); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.
